```{r}
# Resample matched benchmark and targeted expected outcomes on the held-out test sample.
# Keep the selected strategy unchanged across paired bootstrap draws.

required_packages <- c( "tidyverse" )
missing_packages <- required_packages[ !vapply( required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1) ) ]
if ( length( missing_packages ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Install required package(s) before running Module 6B: ", paste( missing_packages, collapse = ", "
      ) ) )
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages( library( tidyverse ) )
options( dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE )
config <- list( input_dir = file.path( "outputs", "pricing_simulation" ), output_dir = file.path( "outputs",
      "pricing_bootstrap_uncertainty" ), n_bootstrap = 5000L, bootstrap_seed = 20260918L, confidence_level = 0.95,
  expected_test_profiles = 10000L, benchmark_strategy = "Technical-pricing benchmark", targeted_strategy =
    "Market-position targeted strategy", minimum_margin_retention = 1.00 )
dir.create(
  config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
```


```{r}
# 1. HELPERS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  ifelse( is.finite( denominator ) & abs( denominator ) > .Machine$double.eps, numerator / denominator, NA_real_ )
}
percentile_interval <- function( x, confidence_level = 0.95
) {
  alpha <- 1 - confidence_level
  stats::quantile( x, probs = c( alpha / 2, 0.5, 1 - alpha / 2 ), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 7 )
}
summarise_bootstrap_metric <- function( data, metric, point_estimate, confidence_level
) {
  values <- data[[metric]]
  interval <- percentile_interval( values, confidence_level = confidence_level )
  tibble( metric = metric, point_estimate = point_estimate, bootstrap_mean = mean( values, na.rm = TRUE ),
    bootstrap_sd = stats::sd( values, na.rm = TRUE ), lower_95 = interval[ 1 ], median = interval[ 2 ], upper_95 =
      interval[ 3 ] )
}
```


```{r}
# 2. READ FINAL FROZEN MODULE 6 OUTPUTS
profile_file <- file.path( config$input_dir, "test_strategy_profile_results.csv" )
comparison_file <- file.path( config$input_dir, "test_strategy_comparison.csv" )
metadata_file <- file.path( config$input_dir, "pricing_strategy_metadata.rds" )
required_files <- c( profile_file, comparison_file, metadata_file )
missing_files <- required_files[ !file.exists( required_files ) ]
if ( length( missing_files ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6B cannot find required frozen Module 6 output(s):\n", paste( missing_files,
        collapse = "\n" ) ) )
}
profile_results <- readr::read_csv( profile_file, show_col_types = FALSE )
strategy_comparison <- readr::read_csv( comparison_file, show_col_types = FALSE )
pricing_metadata <- readRDS( metadata_file )
if ( !identical( as.character( pricing_metadata$module_version ), "M6-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18" )
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6B requires final frozen Module 6 version ", "M6-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18." ) )
}
if ( !identical( pricing_metadata$truth_used_for_strategy_selection, FALSE ) || !identical(
      pricing_metadata$test_outcome_used_for_strategy_selection, FALSE )
) {
  stop( "Frozen Module 6 metadata indicates forbidden TEST/truth use during selection." )
}
```


```{r}
# 3. BUILD THE PAIRED HELD-OUT TEST DATASET
required_profile_columns <- c( "quote_profile_id", "strategy", "technical_premium", "candidate_price",
    "true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability", "true_counterfactual_expected_margin",
    "true_counterfactual_expected_written_premium", "true_counterfactual_expected_claim_cost" )
missing_profile_columns <- setdiff( required_profile_columns, names( profile_results ) )
if ( length( missing_profile_columns ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Required Module 6 TEST profile columns are missing: ", paste( missing_profile_columns,
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
benchmark_profiles <- profile_results %>% filter( strategy == config$benchmark_strategy ) %>% transmute(
    quote_profile_id, technical_premium, benchmark_price = candidate_price, benchmark_true_conversion =
      true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability, benchmark_true_margin =
      true_counterfactual_expected_margin, benchmark_true_written_premium =
      true_counterfactual_expected_written_premium, benchmark_true_claim_cost =
      true_counterfactual_expected_claim_cost )
targeted_profiles <- profile_results %>% filter( strategy == config$targeted_strategy ) %>% transmute(
    quote_profile_id, targeted_price = candidate_price, targeted_true_conversion =
      true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability, targeted_true_margin = true_counterfactual_expected_margin,
    targeted_true_written_premium = true_counterfactual_expected_written_premium, targeted_true_claim_cost =
      true_counterfactual_expected_claim_cost )
paired_test <- benchmark_profiles %>% inner_join( targeted_profiles, by = "quote_profile_id" ) %>% arrange(
    quote_profile_id )
if ( nrow( paired_test ) != config$expected_test_profiles
) {
  stop( paste0( "Expected ", config$expected_test_profiles, " paired TEST profiles but found ", nrow( paired_test
      ), "." ) )
}
if ( anyDuplicated( paired_test$quote_profile_id ) > 0L
) {
  stop( "Paired TEST data contains duplicate quote_profile_id values." )
}
if ( any( !is.finite( unlist( paired_test %>% select( -quote_profile_id ) ) ) )
) {
  stop( "Paired TEST data contains non-finite evaluation values." )
}
```


```{r}
# 4. POINT ESTIMATES FROM THE FROZEN TEST COHORT
calculate_metrics <- function( data
) {
  benchmark_conversion <- mean( data$benchmark_true_conversion )
  targeted_conversion <- mean( data$targeted_true_conversion )
  benchmark_margin <- sum( data$benchmark_true_margin )
  targeted_margin <- sum( data$targeted_true_margin )
  benchmark_written_premium <- sum( data$benchmark_true_written_premium )
  targeted_written_premium <- sum( data$targeted_true_written_premium )
  benchmark_claim_cost <- sum( data$benchmark_true_claim_cost )
  targeted_claim_cost <- sum( data$targeted_true_claim_cost )
  tibble( technical_true_expected_conversion_rate = benchmark_conversion, targeted_true_expected_conversion_rate =
      targeted_conversion, absolute_true_conversion_uplift = targeted_conversion - benchmark_conversion,
    relative_true_conversion_uplift = safe_divide( targeted_conversion - benchmark_conversion, benchmark_conversion
      ), technical_true_expected_underwriting_margin = benchmark_margin,
    targeted_true_expected_underwriting_margin = targeted_margin, true_margin_retention = safe_divide(
        targeted_margin, benchmark_margin ), technical_true_expected_claim_ratio = safe_divide(
        benchmark_claim_cost, benchmark_written_premium ), targeted_true_expected_claim_ratio = safe_divide(
        targeted_claim_cost, targeted_written_premium ), targeted_aggregate_rate_level = safe_divide( sum(
          data$targeted_price ), sum( data$technical_premium ) ) )
}
point_estimates <- calculate_metrics( paired_test )
```


```{r}
# 5. PAIRED NONPARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP
set.seed(
  config$bootstrap_seed )
n_test <- nrow( paired_test )
bootstrap_results <- purrr::map_dfr( seq_len( config$n_bootstrap ), function( b
    ) {
      sampled_rows <- sample.int( n = n_test, size = n_test, replace = TRUE )
      metrics <- calculate_metrics( paired_test[ sampled_rows, , drop = FALSE ] )
      metrics %>% mutate( bootstrap_replication = b, .before = 1 )
    } )
```


```{r}
# 6. BOOTSTRAP INTERVAL SUMMARY
primary_metrics <- c( "absolute_true_conversion_uplift", "relative_true_conversion_uplift",
    "true_margin_retention", "technical_true_expected_claim_ratio", "targeted_true_expected_claim_ratio",
    "targeted_aggregate_rate_level" )
bootstrap_summary <- purrr::map_dfr( primary_metrics, function( metric
    ) {
      summarise_bootstrap_metric( data = bootstrap_results, metric = metric, point_estimate =
          point_estimates[[metric]][1], confidence_level = config$confidence_level )
    } ) %>% mutate( confidence_level = config$confidence_level, bootstrap_replications = config$n_bootstrap )
```


```{r}
# 7. DECISION-STABILITY PROBABILITIES
bootstrap_decision_summary <- tibble( measure = c( "Probability absolute true conversion uplift > 0",
        "Probability relative true conversion uplift > 0", "Probability true margin retention >= 100%",
        "Probability conversion uplift > 0 and margin retention >= 100%" ), bootstrap_probability = c( mean(
          bootstrap_results$absolute_true_conversion_uplift > 0 ), mean(
          bootstrap_results$relative_true_conversion_uplift > 0 ), mean( bootstrap_results$true_margin_retention >=
            config$minimum_margin_retention ), mean( bootstrap_results$absolute_true_conversion_uplift > 0 &
            bootstrap_results$true_margin_retention >= config$minimum_margin_retention ) ) )
```


```{r}
# 8. VALIDATION CHECKS
comparison_benchmark <- strategy_comparison %>% filter( strategy == config$benchmark_strategy )
comparison_targeted <- strategy_comparison %>% filter( strategy == config$targeted_strategy )
bootstrap_validation_checks <- tribble( ~check_name, ~observed_value, ~required_value, ~pass,
    "Paired TEST profiles", nrow( paired_test ), config$expected_test_profiles, nrow( paired_test ) ==
      config$expected_test_profiles, "Unique paired quote profiles", dplyr::n_distinct(
      paired_test$quote_profile_id ), config$expected_test_profiles, dplyr::n_distinct(
      paired_test$quote_profile_id ) == config$expected_test_profiles, "Bootstrap replications", nrow(
      bootstrap_results ), config$n_bootstrap, nrow( bootstrap_results ) == config$n_bootstrap,
    "Frozen Module 6 truth excluded from strategy selection", as.numeric(
      !pricing_metadata$truth_used_for_strategy_selection ), 1, identical(
      pricing_metadata$truth_used_for_strategy_selection, FALSE ),
    "Frozen Module 6 TEST outcome excluded from strategy selection", as.numeric(
      !pricing_metadata$test_outcome_used_for_strategy_selection ), 1, identical(
      pricing_metadata$test_outcome_used_for_strategy_selection, FALSE ),
    "Point absolute conversion uplift reconstructs Module 6", abs( point_estimates$absolute_true_conversion_uplift[
        1 ] - comparison_targeted$true_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] ), 0, abs(
      point_estimates$absolute_true_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] - comparison_targeted$true_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] ) <
      1e-12, "Point relative conversion uplift reconstructs Module 6", abs(
      point_estimates$relative_true_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] - comparison_targeted$true_relative_conversion_uplift[ 1
        ] ), 0, abs( point_estimates$relative_true_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] -
        comparison_targeted$true_relative_conversion_uplift[ 1 ] ) < 1e-12,
    "Point margin retention reconstructs Module 6", abs( point_estimates$true_margin_retention[ 1 ] -
        comparison_targeted$true_margin_retention[ 1 ] ), 0, abs( point_estimates$true_margin_retention[ 1 ] -
        comparison_targeted$true_margin_retention[ 1 ] ) < 1e-12 )
if ( !all( bootstrap_validation_checks$pass )
) {
  print( bootstrap_validation_checks %>% filter( !pass ), n = Inf )
  stop( "One or more Module 6B validation checks failed." )
}
```
